--- input
<THINKINGXYZ onload="alert(1)">
Uno.

Dos.
</THINKINGXYZ>

<Thinking>
Tres.
</thinking onload="alert(1)">

Después.
--- note
A tag name that merely starts with a registered one must not match it, whatever its case; and a closing tag with an attribute is still a closing tag. Neither may keep an event handler, and the unregistered element is unwrapped rather than rendered.
